#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

struct Val {
    long double a, b;
    Val() : a(0), b(0) {}
    Val(long double a_, long double b_) : a(a_), b(b_) {}
    Val operator+(const Val& o) const { return Val(a + o.a, b + o.b); }
    Val operator-(const Val& o) const { return Val(a - o.a, b - o.b); }
    Val operator*(long double w) const { return Val(a * w, b * w); }
    Val operator/(long double w) const { return Val(a / w, b / w); }
};

const int MAXM = 1 << 20;
const double EPS = 1E-9;

vector<Val> dp;
int n, k;
long double p[25];

double Solve(int vr) {
    if (p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

    dp.assign(MAXM, Val());
    dp[0] = Val(1.0L, 0.0L);
    int total = 1 << n;

    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (msk & (1 << vr)) continue;
        Val ri(0.0L, 0.0L);
        long double same = 0.0L;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (i == vr) continue;
            if (msk & (1 << i)) {
                same += p[i];
                ri = ri + dp[msk ^ (1 << i)] * p[i];
            }
        }

        dp[msk] = ri / (1.0L - same);
    }

    Val tot(1.0L, 0.0L);
    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (!(msk & (1 << vr))) {
            tot = tot + dp[msk];
        }
    }

    long double alp = (1.0L - tot.b) / tot.a;

    Val bad(0.0L, 0.0L);
    for (int msk = 0; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (msk & (1 << vr)) continue;
        if (__builtin_popcount(msk) >= k) bad = bad + dp[msk];
    }

    return (double)(1.0L - (alp * bad.a + bad.b));
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> k;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> p[i];

    cout << fixed << setprecision(12);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) cout << ' ';
        cout << (double)Solve(i);
    }
    cout << '\n';

    return 0;
}

    return make_pair(x, y);
}

inline Val addVal(const Val& a, const Val& b) {
    return make_pair(a.first + b.first, a.second + b.second);
}

    const double EPS = 1E-9;
    if (p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

    dp[0] = makeVal(1.0L, 0.0L);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (i != vr && (msk & (1 << i))) {
                same += p[i];
                Val tmp = dp[msk ^ (1 << i)];
                ri.first += tmp.first * p[i];
                ri.second += tmp.second * p[i];
            }

        dp[msk] = makeVal(ri.first / (1.0L - same),

            bad = addVal(bad, dp[msk]);

    return (double)(1.0L - (alp * bad.first + bad.second));

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) scanf("%lf", &p[i]);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) putchar(' ');
        printf("%.12f", Solve(i));
    }
    putchar('\n');

};

int n, k;
dbl p[25];
vector<Val> dp;
vector<char> vis;

Val getDp(int msk, int vr) {
    if (vis[msk]) return dp[msk];
    vis[msk] = 1;

    if (msk == 0) return dp[msk] = Val(1.0L, 0.0L);

    Val ri;
    dbl same = 0.0L;

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i != vr && (msk & (1 << i))) {
            same += p[i];
            Val t = getDp(msk ^ (1 << i), vr);
            ri.a += t.a * p[i];
            ri.b += t.b * p[i];
        }
    }

    return dp[msk] = Val(ri.a / (1.0L - same), ri.b / (1.0L - same));
}

double Solve(int vr) {
    const double EPS = 1E-9;
    if (p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

    fill(vis.begin(), vis.end(), 0);
    dp.assign((size_t)1 << 20, Val());

    int total = 1 << n;
    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk)
        if (!(msk & (1 << vr)))
            getDp(msk, vr);

    Val tot(1.0L, 0.0L);
    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk)

            bad.a += dp[msk].a;
            bad.b += dp[msk].b;
        }

    return (double)(1.0L - (alp * bad.a + bad.b));
}

    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    cin >> n >> k;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) cin >> p[i];

    dp.resize((size_t)1 << 20);
    vis.resize((size_t)1 << 20);

    cout << fixed << setprecision(12);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

        cout << (double)Solve(i);

    const double EPS = 1E-9;
    if (p[vr] < EPS) return 0.0;

    A[0] = 1.0L;
    B[0] = 0.0L;

    int total = 1 << n;

    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (msk & (1 << vr)) continue;

        dbl a = 0.0L, b = 0.0L, same = 0.0L;

            if (i != vr && (msk & (1 << i))) {
                same += p[i];
                a += A[msk ^ (1 << i)] * p[i];
                b += B[msk ^ (1 << i)] * p[i];
            }
        }

        A[msk] = a / (1.0L - same);
        B[msk] = b / (1.0L - same);
    }

    dbl ta = 1.0L, tb = 0.0L;
    for (int msk = 1; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (!(msk & (1 << vr))) {
            ta += A[msk];
            tb += B[msk];
        }
    }

    dbl alp = (1.0L - tb) / ta;

    dbl ba = 0.0L, bb = 0.0L;
    for (int msk = 0; msk < total; ++msk) {
        if (!(msk & (1 << vr)) && __builtin_popcount(msk) >= k) {
            ba += A[msk];
            bb += B[msk];
        }
    }

    return (double)(1.0L - (alp * ba + bb));
}

    scanf("%d%d", &n, &k);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) scanf("%lf", &p[i]);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) putchar(' ');
        printf("%.12f", Solve(i));
    }
    putchar('\n');

    return 0;
}

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long double dbl;
const int MAXM = 1 << 20;
const double EPS = 1E-9;

struct Val {
    dbl coeff, cnst;
    Val(dbl c = 0.0L, dbl k = 0.0L) : coeff(c), cnst(k) {}
};

typedef array<Val, MAXM> DpArray;
static DpArray dp;

int n, k;
double prob[25];

double Solve(int victim) {
    if (prob[victim] < EPS) return 0.0;

    dp.fill(Val());
    dp[0] = Val(1.0L, 0.0L);

    int total = 1 << n;
    int vbit = 1 << victim;

    for (int mask = 1; mask < total; ++mask) {
        if (mask & vbit) continue;

        Val cur(0.0L, 0.0L);
        dbl same = 0.0L;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (i == victim) continue;
            if (mask & (1 << i)) {
                same += prob[i];
                const Val& prev = dp[mask ^ (1 << i)];
                cur.coeff += prev.coeff * prob[i];
                cur.cnst += prev.cnst * prob[i];
            }
        }

        dp[mask].coeff = cur.coeff / (1.0L - same);
        dp[mask].cnst = cur.cnst / (1.0L - same);
    }

    Val totalVal(1.0L, 0.0L);
    for (int mask = 1; mask < total; ++mask) {
        if (!(mask & vbit)) {
            totalVal.coeff += dp[mask].coeff;
            totalVal.cnst += dp[mask].cnst;
        }
    }

    dbl alpha = (1.0L - totalVal.cnst) / totalVal.coeff;

    Val badVal(0.0L, 0.0L);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < total; ++mask) {
        if (!(mask & vbit) && __builtin_popcount(mask) >= k) {
            badVal.coeff += dp[mask].coeff;
            badVal.cnst += dp[mask].cnst;
        }
    }

    return (double)(1.0L - (alpha * badVal.coeff + badVal.cnst));
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d%d", &n, &k);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) scanf("%lf", &prob[i]);

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (i) putchar(' ');
        printf("%.12f", Solve(i));
    }
    putchar('\n');

    return 0;
}
